headline: Nvidia just showed that the harness, not the AI model, is now the real hero
snapshot: Nvidia research shows that AI agents can perform well, and not go off the deep end, through fine-tuning, even if the AI model isn't that great at the task. The larger angle is AI infrastructure: compute capacity, chip access and data-center economics are increasingly determining which companies can scale products for enterprise and government customers.
